level.title: Danish C1 Proficient: Seniors 65-75, academic, storytelling, heritage
level.description: Complete Danish C1 course for Proficient. Seniors 65-75, academic, storytelling, heritage. Includes 8 lessons, 250-300 study hours, visual learning with senior characters, country context from DK, dotted tracing, and cultural themes.
goals: Master C1 level Danish for proficient
Learn 96 new words about daily life in Danish-speaking countries
Practice with visual aids: senior characters, country flags, cultural motifs
Complete 20 test questions and dotted tracing worksheets
